name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Urdu
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-12): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0.
verdict_reason: The Urdu files have 'Dakshina' and 'Existing' rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops (the project's licence audit keeps them out of a pack): 73,666 Dakshina and 2,554 Existing rows of urd_train.json are dropped by the filter. What is used is mined (IndicCorp: CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Uni: CC BY).
used_for: urd_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, and the manual AK-Uni rows) as transliterator training pairs for packs/ur.neopack (30% of train.tsv; the rest is spelled from the romanisation tables, mlkb.langs.pairs). urd_valid.json has no manual rows, so a held-out 25% (by word) of urd_train.json's AK-Uni rows calibrates the romanised Urdu tables (data/langs/ur/romanisation-weights.json) and validates training (valid-human.tsv); those words are in no training pair. urd_test.json's manual rows (AK-Uni, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY; 4,427, of which 4,408 distinct pairs after cleaning) are the held-out eval set, data/eval/ur/translit-human.tsv: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-12. Extract with: unzip urd.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-urd/extracted (data/build-ur-text.sh does). urd_train.json has 699,024 rows: IndicCorp 620,359, Dakshina 73,666, Existing 2,554, AK-Uni 2,445. urd_valid.json 12,419: Dakshina 9,627, IndicCorp 2,792 (no manual rows). urd_test.json 14,878: Dakshina 10,451, AK-Uni 2,437, AK-NEI 1,174, AK-NEF 816. Aksharantar's Urdu native side almost never writes short-vowel marks (zer, zabar, pesh), as Urdu is usually written: 798 of the 713,902 rows of urd_train.json and urd_test.json have one, which data/langs/ur/lang.json's replace pairs strip. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/ur.neopack (credited in its manifest), not listed on the download site yet, not in the app
